name: qlrisk_price_abs
title: Price a ABS
description:
Price one Asset-Backed Securities (qlrisk ABS): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), face_value (amount; default 100), spread_bp (basis points, 25 = 0.25%; default 100), coupon_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 5), cpr_pct (percent, 3 = 3%; default 10), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, issuer, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 99.43 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
